title: SUSHI ten-subject expansion
release_policy: Release new imported items in the app as requested. Preserve all original CSV fields and source review notes in raw metadata. This change integrates supplied content and does not claim a new clinical source review.
preservation: Original bank.json and legacy import hash unchanged.
Existing question IDs, positions, versions, edits, accounts, learner history and saved exam snapshots preserved.
Original four-subject achievements retain their core subject scope.
No schema migration needed. Seed appends missing items only.
features: All ten subjects in Fresh Catch, Maki Mentor, Wasabi Rush, Memory Maki, Roll Call, Bento Builder and analytics.
Six new subject portraits and six Meet the Chef achievements.
51 achievements and 52 character avatar choices including the starter.
Each new subject avatar unlocks at 50 distinct correct practice answers; assigned exam answers are excluded as with existing subject rewards.
Portrait frame selection remains independent of character and tier.
Login displays ten subject characters; achievement totals are derived dynamically.

characters.subject: Preventive Medicine
characters.name: Kappa Care
characters.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single transparent square mascot for SUSHI medical exam study app. Match the existing SUSHI subject mascot visible in conversation: adorable plump sushi food creature, ivory rice face, huge friendly glossy burgundy eyes, rosy cheeks, thick rounded burgundy outlines, warm pink and salmon palette, polished soft vector-like shading. Full body centered, small arms and feet, all props fully in frame, generous transparent margin, readable at 64px. Actual alpha transparency. One character only. No words, lettering, watermark, frame, background, or extra characters. Create 'Kappa Care', the Preventive Medicine mascot: a cheerful cucumber maki roll with green cucumber slices visible on its head and burgundy nori sides, wearing a mint community health vest. Holding a rounded mint shield with a small pink heart emblem and a tiny leafy sprout. Embodies prevention and community care, with a welcoming open pose. Distinct cucumber-green accents.
